basis: PREREG_H1_TF F12.6 (F12-I constructions); Board A F12 review conditions 8 (supports, bitwise sum, no-op halves, Astra only if qualified) and 9 (linear versus quadratic forecasts; zero-edit-centred)

rules.floor: F8a floor h* = 0.00493967211805284 nats/token (floor_recompute_2026-11-11.json); above floor iff |I| > h* strictly; reported beside I, not a significance threshold
rules.forecasts: zero-fit, zero-edit-centred (no intercept): linear I = 0 for every split; quadratic I = 0 for disjoint-tensor splits and q(full) - q(p1) - q(p2) for the within-tensor column split
rules.noop: a part with zero realised increment is not written or scored; its entry's I is undefined
rules.part: full stored delta restricted to a disjoint support, applied to the base and rounded in bf16; realised parts sum bitwise to the full realised increment (verified, fails closed)
rules.statistic: I = Delta y(full) - Delta y(part1) - Delta y(part2) on the common base reference (F12.6)
